note: ECOWAS's free movement: each member grants the others' citizens the right of residence to seek and carry out income-earning employment and to take up employment under the rules for national workers (Supplementary Protocol A/SP.1/7/86, arts. 2–3), the civil service excepted; the ECOWAS residence card or permit is the stay's, not a permission to work. The members are the twelve the Commission lists (Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger having left in 2025; their citizens aren't named). The list gives no rule for other passports.

sources.title: ECOWAS, Supplementary Protocol A/SP.1/7/86 on the Second Phase (Right of Residence) of the Protocol on Free Movement of Persons, the Right of Residence and Establishment
sources.said: each of the Member States shall grant to citizens of the Community who are nationals of other ... Member States, the right of residence in its territory for the purpose of seeking and ... carrying out income earning employment. ... to reside in one of the Member States in order to take up employment in ... accordance with the legislative and administrative provisions governing ... employment of national workers;

sources.title: ECOWAS, Member States
sources.said: Benin ... Cabo Verde ... Côte d’Ivoire ... Ghana ... Guinea ... Guinea Bissau ... Liberia ... Nigeria ... Senegal ... Sierra Leone ... The Gambia ... Togo
